reviewed_scope: The complete 6,036-byte candidate and 5,333-byte diff were read. The unique inverse diff produced the 5,049-byte base, then the exact immutable base blob 31297722805be956745f9f39507539f2719f8b13 was independently fetched and matched byte for byte. The author independently confirmed that base identity.
The unbound readiness refusal runs before umask, stdin processing, directory creation and publication. Missing private-binding length/hash also cannot pass decode/hash validation before BASE.mkdir.
Exactly eight PINS names are accepted, including only the fixed inputs/ descendants and the fixed top-level build-binding.private.json. No caller-provided arbitrary name or path can reach publish.
All payload base64, lengths and SHA256 are checked before directory creation. Only the three fixed .py files are passed to compile(...,'exec'); no compile result is evaluated or module imported.
Fresh BASE is checked absent and created 0700; inputs is created 0700 under it. sync_dir(BASE) persists the inputs directory entry and fsync(PARENT) persists the fresh BASE entry.

Each nested payload's temporary file is in its own fixed destination directory. O_EXCL publication, ownership/mode/readback/nine-field checks, exclusive link, same-inode temporary unlink and fsync(destination.parent) preserve the existing atomic file publication mechanism for inputs/ as well as BASE.
The fixed receipt remains under BASE. The candidate records no Git, compiler, artifact transfer or service start. No child, network, Cargo or source execution is introduced.
limits_and_qualification: The 524288-byte stdin cap is a new explicitly bounded public transport size, not an inherited 262144 cap.
This publisher itself has no new internal clock enforcement; the future exact dispatched outer deadline and whole request remain separate root admission requirements.
The existing same-UID fresh-directory/exact-file design is preserved; this review does not upgrade it into held-parent-FD directory custody.
No host execution, AST run, payload execution, Rust build or eight-input final-bound qualification was performed in this peer review.
The final actual private-binding pins, ACTUAL_INPUTS_READY change, payload, dispatcher argv and root GO remain outstanding before execution.
